errors.text_span: DNN-HMM 方法的柱状图高度最高
errors.evidence: This statement is not true for all test sets. In Test2, the bar for DNN-HMM is approximately the same height as the bar for TDNN-HMM (both around 38%), not strictly the highest.
The description interprets a higher EDR% as "best performance". While this is a reasonable inference, it is an interpretation that goes beyond describing the visual data presented in the chart.

This statement is incorrect. In Test1, the EDR% for LSTM-HMM (approx. 21%) is higher than for End-to-End (approx. 17%). Similarly, in Test2, LSTM-HMM (approx. 19%) is higher than End-to-End (approx. 16%). Therefore, LSTM-HMM is not the weakest in all test sets.

errors.text_span: 其柱状图高度在所有测试集中均低于 20%
errors.evidence: The bar for LSTM-HMM in Test1 is clearly above the 20% line, at approximately 21%. Therefore, the statement that its height is always below 20% is factually incorrect.
The stated range for the End-to-End method is incorrect. In Test2, the value for End-to-End is approximately 16%, which is outside the specified range of 17% to 22%.

This comparative statement about the End-to-End method is incorrect. In Test1 and Test2, the End-to-End method has a lower EDR% than the LSTM-HMM method, meaning it is not 'slightly better' in those cases.
